alternative.scope: Owner proposal only. Keep the exact 10% focus decision, anchor selection and inspired fallback unchanged; keep all choices outside this three-record cohort unchanged. Keep its existing total probability mass. authoring_time_measurement.scope: First official ticket inspection through report construction; excludes any future proposed owner experiment.

bounded_owner_test.decision_rule: Consider an owner-controlled reallocation only if observed quality/cost improves at least 15%, a paired bootstrap 95% lower confidence bound for the improvement is above zero, all three representation floors remain, and no label/leakage regression occurs. Otherwise retain the current allocation and report inconclusive or no improvement. Any adoption needs its own source-bound approval; no current policy or training admission changes.
immediate_stops: Any wrong Racket label, undeclared public/private leakage, changed source binding or ambiguous demonstration advertised as identifiable stops that record; retain evidence.
Unsupported four-query or required parameter controls are a measured gap; do not silently fall back to one query or waive documented demonstration requirements.
Stop at the first attempt, reviewer-time, Racket-CPU or wallclock cap; do not expand to a census.
plan: Use deterministic disjoint seeds and preserve each generator documented demonstration minimum; request exactly four queries. Do not reuse private query answers to design demonstrations.

Measure label parity, input validation/rejection, declared-rival ambiguity, public-challenge duplication and costs on the same per-record cohort; compute both allocation estimates from these shared observations. Keep Racket startup and execution costs separate.
